evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: The first-person plural 'We ratified' enacts communal-sharing: a collective body ratifying as one, not an individual decision or a hierarchical command.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The either/or framing presents two reciprocal, even-handed paths for retrieving results — turn-taking parity between polling and piggybacking, an equality-matching structure of equivalent exchanges.
